contexts.text: These Sirens are obsolete lusts of venery.
On those who exercise venery without... any desire to procreate offspring. (Their grievous punishment described. SE 1203.)
(The use and attendant pleasure of venery. Explained.)
With such a dishonourable venereal heat are they possessed.
On a woman who desired promiscuous venery.
Such could excite from my memory all the venereal things which had been thought in me, even from my infancy...
I perceived, in the street, their venereal cupidities, when I saw... Quaker women.
(Such) have lost all that pleasurableness which what is venereal is usually attended with.
He was amazed that he so suddenly burned with venereal heat (caused by the magical art of a female Spirit).
